verdict.rationale: The docs describe a clear payment flow: the Payments API, Mollie-hosted checkout pages, optional Components or a build-your-own checkout, and webhooks for status updates. An isolated test mode lets you walk through payments and simulate states, so a working integration from the docs alone is plausible. However, nothing in the evidence shows copy-paste code samples or official SDKs per language, and nothing confirms the under-a-day timeline. Missing for 10: per-language copy-paste code examples/SDKs, hands-on or independent evidence of integration time under a day.
